primary_hypotheses.question: Does a classifier fitted only on X carry development-label signal toD?
primary_hypotheses.descriptive_success_rule: Across all three fixed initialization seeds, meanOA>0.5 AND meanNLL<log(2); report each seed and paired OA/NLL gap toD-fitted local reference. No significance or population claim.

primary_hypotheses.question: Does the reverse source-only classifier carry signal toX?
primary_hypotheses.descriptive_success_rule: Same rule, assessed separately; report each seed and paired gap toX-fitted local reference. Existing exposed X evaluation cannot be upgraded to independent confirmation.

budget_if_separately_authorized.runtime_notice: Measured profile and renewed training authority required before launch; no timing or training permission inferred from this draft.

access_and_selection.source_stages: One scene's fit arrays only, fixed analytic feature function and fresh RNG; freeze and hash all source endpoints before any evaluation-array read. Other scene source fits are separate control arms and cannot alter a transfer source endpoint.
access_and_selection.ingress: Reuse C6 authenticated ReleasedBank/patch extraction after exact original product/role records and any format conversion are admitted; reuse C8 transform/model/auditor. C7 PairInputs is not a water/forest adapter and must not be used under its unchanged admission.
access_and_selection.context: Original role-local7x7 clipped context with replicated edges. Nominal full side5.11m onX versus210m onHyperion, not equal ground area. No whole-scene graph, halo or target-statistics fit.
access_and_selection.membership: X keeps original releasedK5/V5 identities for raw2/6. D/L require custodian-approved, parent-disjoint project roles within public training scenes; eligibility fixed before deterministic SHA256 ranking using task_id/scene/role/common_class/original_point_id, selecting5 per class. Missing support blocks the affected protocol; no automatic scene/class replacement.
access_and_selection.target_metadata: Class definitions/device/version descriptions are known during protocol design; report this exposure. No unqualified pristine-target or causal-device claim.

statistics.constant_reference: Balanced two-class p=0.5 hasOA/AA0.5,NLLlog(2),binaryBrier0.25; exact tie predicts0
statistics.per_endpoint: Confusion2x2,class denominators5/5,OA,AA,macroF1,NLL,Brier; all registered cells/three seeds
statistics.pairing: Within the same target point set and seed: every cross-scene source versus that target's local source; additionallyX→L versusD→L andX→D versusL→D. No point pairing across different scenes.
statistics.uncertainty: Observed-parent descriptive sensitivity only. Exact ordered cluster enumeration ifm<=3; ifm>3,10000 resamples with RNG seed531064 fixed before labels/scores, recording undefined-class draw counts and linear2.5/97.5 percentiles. C8 exact-enumeration helper cannot be silently called beyond its3-parent cap; bounded extension needs implementation/test after ingress admission.
statistics.repetition: Three model seeds are initialization repeats;D/L are named same-family scenes with unverified geographic/acquisition independence. Do not multiply unique sample count by directions, cells or seeds.
